_comment: Cycle 1 step 2. Basis: 'Benchmark gap' or 'Best practice'. Analyst-side only (no sealed data used).

hypotheses.title: Free-shipping progress bar in the bag
hypotheses.observation: 1.24 items per order (benchmark 2.9). 41% of orders pay shipping and 20% fall just under the €100 free-shipping threshold.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Because many baskets end just below €100, we believe showing progress towards free shipping ('€18 to free shipping') in the bag will make shoppers add another item, raising items per order and revenue per visitor.
hypotheses.change: Progress bar with the remaining amount at the top of the slide-in bag and cart; turns green with 'Free shipping unlocked' at €100.

hypotheses.title: Mobile bag: make checkout the obvious next step
hypotheses.observation: Only 35% of mobile shoppers with a full bag start checkout vs 64% on desktop; mobile cart abandonment is 70%.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Because mobile shoppers see a long bag with the Checkout button pushed down and no reassurance, we believe a sticky Checkout button with delivery and returns reassurance in the bag will raise mobile checkout starts.
hypotheses.change: Sticky footer in the slide-in bag on mobile: subtotal, prominent Checkout button, and a line with '30-day free returns · delivery in 1–2 days'.

hypotheses.title: Sticky Add to bag on mobile product pages
hypotheses.observation: Mobile product pages convert views to add-to-bag at 5–7.5% vs 7.6–13.9% on desktop, in every category. Product pages are now long (copy, specs, reviews).
hypotheses.hypothesis: Because mobile shoppers scroll into copy, specs and reviews and lose the Add to bag button, we believe a sticky Add to bag bar (price + button) that appears once the main button scrolls away will raise mobile add-to-bag rate.
hypotheses.change: Bottom sticky bar on mobile PDPs with product name, price and Add to bag, shown when the main button is out of view; asks for size if none selected.

hypotheses.title: 'Complete your kit' on product pages
hypotheses.observation: Baskets are small (1.24 items) and accessories are cheap add-ons (€31–65) that rarely get added alongside jackets, boots and packs.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Because shoppers buying a main item are not shown matching accessories, we believe a 'Complete your kit' row with quick add will raise items per order.
hypotheses.change: Row of 3 matching accessories under Add to bag, each with image, price, stars and a quick '+ Add' button.
hypotheses.primary_metric: items per order / revenue per visitor

hypotheses.title: Helpful zero-result search page
hypotheses.observation: 15% of searches return nothing (all for 'tent'), and those sessions end with a dead-end 'No products found'.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Because a dead-end search page gives shoppers nowhere to go, we believe suggesting related categories and popular products on zero-result searches will keep them browsing and raise product views from search.
hypotheses.change: Zero-result page with 'We don't sell tents yet', links to related categories (Backpacks, Accessories) and a row of 4 bestsellers.
